'''Shamdon Kree''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of the [[Smugglers' Alliance]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Shamdon Kree lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and served as pilot trainer in [[Valarian/Legends|Lady Valarian's]] [[Valarian Syndicate|criminal organization]]. She was also a member of the [[Smugglers' Alliance|Smuggler Alliance]] led by [[Talon Karrde]].<ref name="SWG:JtL" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the Smuggler Alliance recruited a number of freelancer pilots and formed a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]]. Based in the [[Lucky Despot]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], Shamdon Kree dispatched the Smuggler Alliance pilots in a series of missions to defend the interests of Lady Valarian's organization. These missions included the destruction of [[Canyon Corsairs|Corsair]] starfighters in the [[Karthakk system]], elimination of [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Ace/Legends|aces]] in the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]], escort of Valarian [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] against [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] pirates in the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo system]], destruction of an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] patrol in the [[Dantooine system/Legends|Dantooine system]]. Later, secondary missions also included escort of transports in the Karthakk system, hijacking of Imperial transports in the Dantooine system and destruction of Black Sun fighters in the Yavin system.<ref name="SWG:JtL" />
